name: B10/B11 Follow-conditional NPC loot and smart routing observation — prepared disposable save; NOT RUN

steps._note: Final batch only. Put an owned human (and separately a same-owner dog) on Follow using real command UI, with Smart Looting ON, a legally accessible first-touch unopened container and a corpse/source nearby. Record owner, source incarnation/generation, lock state, NPC worn search mods, NPC/player/dog inventories, category destination, source remainder and baseline loot stage. No player proxy open or fabricated loot source. Observe the real autonomous Follow activity after combat/keep-up priorities. Bridge capture alone cannot prove native NPC opener identity, lock/crate rules, first-touch generation, exact-item receipt, routing, overflow or no base-work resumption; inspect authoritative source/custody records and repeat with Smart Looting OFF and a foreign-owned companion.
